title: Drivers received 78% of ride-hail base fares in Aug 2026

subtitles.driver_share_trend: Drivers' share of the base fare rose 0.5 pts on Uber and fell 2.5 pts on Lyft between Aug 2025 and Aug 2026
subtitles.pay_per_hour_trend: Ride-hail drivers earned $64.71 per hour with a passenger in Aug 2026 (+2.5% on a year earlier)
subtitles.event_study: Net of the same weeks of 2024, ride-hail driver pay per minute with a passenger fell 0.9% and pay per mile fell 1.2% in the 12 weeks after the new minimum-pay rule, against the 12 weeks before
subtitles.hours: Ride-hail vehicles made 1.74 trips/hour worked in Aug 2026, against 1.63 trips/hour for yellow cabs and 1.24 trips/hour for green cabs (TLC-reported)
